record.issue_text: Stale validation state never cleared in AddGuestsDialog.tsx:33,36-45: isInvalidEmail is only reset by the Cancel button (not on input change, success, or reopen), so the error banner persists while fixing emails and reappears on next open; email state also survives ESC/overlay close

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed `safeParse` in `handleAdd`, but it is only reset in the explicit Cancel button handler. There is no reset on input change (`setMultiEmailValue` updates don’t touch `isInvalidEmail`), so the error banner can remain visible while the user fixes emails. Also, closing the dialog via `Dialog`’s `onOpenChange` (ESC/overlay) only toggles `isOpenDialog`; it does not reset `isInvalidEmail` or `multiEmailValue`, so those states persist and will reappear on next open since the component stays mounted in `BookingListItem`.
